artworks.title: La morgue, Paris (The Mortuary)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed urban scene viewed from a slight elevation. In the foreground, small boats are parked along a waterway, with people inside. Beyond that, there is a quay with people engaged in various activities. A stone wall leads up to a roofed structure with small windows adjacent to a large stone building. Further back, there are tall, multi-story buildings with narrow chimneys releasing smoke. The skyline is filled with these buildings, creating a densely built area. The image uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture, shadow, and depth. It is monochrome, typical of an etching, emphasizing details through contrast.

artworks.title: La galerie Notre-Dame, Paris (The Gallery of Notre Dame, Paris)
artworks.description: Drawing of an intricate architectural scene with Gothic arches and columns. High level of detail in the architectural elements, typical of the Gothic period. Lofty interior or exterior gallery with pointed arches and ornate column capitals. Cityscape in the background. Emphasizes verticality and intricate decorative patterns of Gothic architecture.

artworks.title: Le Petit Pont, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on green laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a Parisian street scene with Notre-Dame's towers in the background. The scene also includes a river, people, and boats. The artwork appears to be an etching with fine lines and a sepia tone color palette.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The painting features a central figure on a wooden cross, with an inscription above the cross. The figure is shown with a crown of thorns and blood depicted dripping from hands, feet, and side. On either side of the central figure are two figures, draped in vibrant garments; the figure on the left wears a rich blue, while the figure on the right dons a combination of green and pink. Each of these side figures has a halo. The background of the image is a deep, dark tone, contrasting with the earthy ground and the figures’ clothing. This is in the style of medieval or early Renaissance European religious art.

artworks.title: A Lectern Cloth with the Marriage at Cana
artworks.medium: woodcut on linen, hand-colored in brown and red

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures. In the center, a figure is crucified on a wooden cross with arms outstretched and feet together, bearing a halo above their head. This person has long dark hair, wearing a crown of thorns and draped with a white cloth around the lower half of their body. To the left, another figure stands hunched in mourning, with a halo, wearing a blue robe and a white veil over their head. On the right, a standing figure with curly auburn hair and a halo, appears to be a young male. This person wears a blue tunic covered by a white robe, holds a book in their left hand, and their right hand is raised to their chest. The background is golden with decorative patterns on the sides, and greenery under the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval illuminated manuscript page. The artwork depicts a central figure seated on a throne under a grand arch, holding a book and gesturing towards a group of standing figures. The background is decorated with floral patterns and roundels, showcasing colors including blue, red, yellow, and green. Surrounding the scene are architectural elements, such as arches and columns. The attire of the figures and decoration reflect the artistic style associated with illuminated manuscripts. This is in the style of an anonymous medieval illuminator.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The painting depicts a central figure on a cross, flanked by figures on either side, set against a rich gilded background with a star pattern around the border. The central figure is draped in a blue cloth around the waist and is suspended with arms outstretched. The figures on either side appear to be in various states of mourning or reverence, some dressed in robes, with two armored figures present as well. Below, two kneeling figures hold a scroll with inscriptions. The use of blue and gold colors, as well as the intricate pattern, lends the work a sense of opulence and solemnity. This is in the style of medieval manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Birth of John the Baptist
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene from a medieval manuscript. The image shows a group surrounding a central figure in a cradle, within a complex floral and architectural frame. The decorations include vines, leaves, and gold detailing. In the center, a character in a red cloak with a halo directs attention towards another figure draped in white. The composition includes a background architectural element, emphasizing a solemn assembly. The border is detailed with flourishes and vivid colors like blues, reds, and greens interwoven with gilded accents.

artworks.title: The Nativity with the Annunciation to the Shepherds
Saint Peter Enthroned
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated and facing forward, showing their upper body and part of their lower body. The individual has a mature face with a grey beard and wears an ornate, pointed hat. The clothing is detailed with a pattern of alternating spots and crosses in gold, red, and white. The person holds a staff in one hand and a book in the other, both adorned in gold. The background is golden, and the figure is set against a backdrop of intricate blue and red swirls and leaf-like designs. The immediate background includes a decorated, bright border with floral patterns, vivid colors, and geometric designs. Surrounding the image are portions of medieval musical notation and text in elaborate script.

artworks.title: Saint Maurice and the Theban Legion
artworks.description: This is a painting of knights in armor featuring a medieval manuscript. The image is a highly ornate illumination with intricate details and vibrant colors. The central figures are clad in armor, surrounded by a border with elaborate designs including floral and vegetal motifs in gold, green, and blue, as well as other symbolic elements. The background includes a landscape and architectural features with historical ambiance. The right side is inscribed with the text "S. MAURITI."

artworks.title: Lamentation for Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a figure surrounded by mourners and symbolic objects. The lifeless figure lies in the foreground, partially covered with fabric, with arms and legs prominently visible. Two figures weep on either side while a ladder leans against a large vertical timber in the background. Various objects lie at the base of the timber, including a pot, a smaller cylindrical container, and tools resembling nails. The composition is expressive and strongly delineated, typical of woodcut prints influenced by Northern Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Lamentation for Christ
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with dramatic figures in a landscape. The image features a central figure with a halo, holding and gazing at another reclining figure on the ground. The figures are surrounded by a pastoral landscape, including trees and distant hills. The work appears to be done in a detailed, woodcut style typical of early printmaking, using intricate lines to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: Bathsheba at Her Bath
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene set in a medieval town. The drawing features a courtyard-like setting with a fountain at the center, adorned with a sculpture. An archway leads to buildings with arches, windows, and traditional rooftops in the background. In the foreground, two figures are near the fountain base, one seated and the other standing. Various objects are scattered around the fountain's edge. A lush garden with shaped trees provides contrast to the textures of the townsfolk's clothing and the stone architecture. The intricate lines and hatchings create a detailed portrayal of the medieval town environment, capturing a blend of ornate and everyday life.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 4.2 cm (2 3/8 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two figures interacting. On the left, a person is sitting on a chair, facing slightly right. The person has delicate facial features, curly hair, and is wearing long robes. A table with a lace cloth and an open book is next to them. On the right, an angelic figure is kneeling on a cloud, with curly hair, holding a staff, and visible wings. The background features an archway, rays emanating from a point, swirling clouds, and heavy curtains to the left.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed within plate mark): 3.5 × 2.3 cm (1 3/8 × 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic visitation in a modestly furnished room. The image depicts an angel with wings, holding a staff, leaning towards another figure seated by a table with a book. The scene includes a vase with a plant that separates the two figures. Above them is another figure surrounded by clouds. The composition is enclosed within an octagonal frame, with shading and lines creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: The Holy Family at Table
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.5 × 16.9 cm (7 11/16 × 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic interior scene with a religious or spiritual theme. The image includes a round table set with dishes and a lit candle, casting soft light and creating halos around the figures' heads. The figures are engaged in an intimate moment, with the central figure leaning forward to hand a cup to another. The artwork's details highlight the play of light and shadow, creating depth and warmth. The image is enclosed within a circular frame. Latin inscriptions add to the religious or philosophical undertones.

artworks.title: The Card Players
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark [irreg.]): 21.5 × 27.7 cm (8 7/16 × 10 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring several figures in elaborate period attire gathered around a table. The figures are engaged in an activity, with various objects on the table. A candle illuminates the scene, and Latin text is inscribed around the edge of the oval image. The dark background enhances the central vignette.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Capricci"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate text arrangement featuring mythical figures and decorative elements. The drawing depicts a central text in Italian, framed by two mythical figures resembling fauns or satyrs on either side. They are crouched over an intricately designed scroll or banner, their muscular bodies and wild hair rendered with detailed line work. Above the text, an emblem with a crown and shield is prominently featured, flanked by an ornate crest. The text honors Iacopo Callot and Don Lorenzo Medici. The composition is carefully balanced, with intricate lines and shading giving depth to the figures and decorative borders.

artworks.title: Dedication to Don Lorenzo de' Medici
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a letter addressed to Don Lorenzo de Medici. The drawing features ornate calligraphic text, with an elaborate initial 'L' in the upper left-hand corner, framed by a decorative border. The text, in Italian, appears to be a formal dedication. It includes intricate, flowing script. The layout is rectangular, with the text neatly contained within the borders. Written by Iacopo Callot, this piece reflects a blend of calligraphy and textual design.

artworks.title: Gentleman and His Page
artworks.description: The image contains two full-body sketches of the same person in different poses on a plain background. The sketch on the left shows the person in a dynamic, forward-leaning pose with one arm extended forward and the other hand holding a mask. The person has an open mouth, a prominent nose, curly hair, and is dressed in a long-sleeved shirt, a vertically striped vest, breeches, knee-high boots, and a sword at the side. The sketch on the right shows the person facing away with a hand on the hip and the other hand holding the mask. The person's features, hair, and clothing are consistent with the left sketch.
